## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install nbdev_hello_world in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure nbdev_hello_world package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to nbdev_hello_world
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/eitanlees/nbdev-hello-world):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/eitanlees/nbdev-hello-world.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/eitanlees/nbdev-hello-world)

``` sh
$ conda install -c eitanlees nbdev_hello_world
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nbdev-hello-world/)

``` sh
$ pip install nbdev_hello_world
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/eitanlees/nbdev-hello-world)’s
[pages](https://eitanlees.github.io/nbdev-hello-world/). Additionally
you can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/eitanlees/nbdev-hello-world) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nbdev-hello-world/) respectively.
